name: Hannah
title: Samuel's mother
summary: Hannah was a devout woman who suffered from infertility while her husband's other wife mocked her. She prayed earnestly to God in the tabernacle and vowed that if she had a son, he would be dedicated to the Lord's service. God heard her prayer, and she gave birth to Samuel, who became one of Israel's greatest prophets.

keyEvents.title: Mocked by Peninnah
keyEvents.description: Hannah was childless while Elkanah's other wife, Peninnah, had children. Peninnah mocked her year after year.

keyEvents.title: The Earnest Prayer
keyEvents.description: Hannah wept and prayed in the tabernacle, vowing that if God gave her a son, he would be dedicated to the Lord forever.

keyEvents.title: Eli's Blessing
keyEvents.description: The priest Eli first thought she was drunk, but when he understood her situation, he blessed her.

keyEvents.title: Samuel's Birth and Dedication
keyEvents.description: Hannah gave birth to Samuel and brought him to the tabernacle when he was weaned, to serve the Lord under Eli.

keyEvents.title: Hannah's Song of Praise
keyEvents.description: Hannah sang a powerful song of praise that honored God for His faithfulness—a precursor to Mary's Magnificat.
